patches: REPAIR 1 (common/scanner.h, scan_pi_content): the trailing `advance_if_eq(lexer, chr)` became `skip_if_eq`. `advance_if_eq` is defined as `if (!eof && lookahead==chr) advance(); else return false`, so its `else` ABORTED a token whose value the test could not affect — the statements run past `mark_end`, so they are pure lookahead. A processing instruction WITH CONTENT therefore produced no `_pi_content` token at all, the construct could not complete, and the parser wrapped it in an ERROR node; with no XMLDecl the enclosing `prolog` was destroyed too, taking any DOCTYPE in it. Isolated to the byte by a 19-shape battery: the construct parses iff the byte after `?>` is a newline.

REPAIR 2 (xml/grammar.js, _intSubset): `repeat(choice($._markupdecl, $.conditionalSect, $._DeclSep))` over a named `_intSubsetItem`, plus a `conditionalSect` rule. Upstream could not reach a conditional section from an internal subset at ANY version measured — 0.5.0-0.6.x declare `conditionalSect` in the `dtd` grammar and inline it, but `_intSubset` referenced `$._markupdecl`, which does not include it; 0.7.0 does not declare it in the `xml` grammar at all. The failure wrapped the `doctypedecl` in an ERROR, the parser took a LATER `Name` as the DTD's name, and the analyzer published a Type symbol literally called `INCLUDE`.
grammarPin.patchAdmissibility: 8,888 corpus files / 6.69M nodes, ERROR and MISSING counted per file: 31 files repaired, 2 moved, 8,855 unchanged, corpus MISSING nodes 32 -> 10. BOTH movements are adjudicated by measurement in fixtures/xml/out/regression-adjudication.json: one is a standalone `.dtd` (root ERROR under every build, so never in the wired surface; upstream's separate `dtd` grammar parses it with 0 ERROR nodes) and the other is libxml2's own fuzzer-regression directory, kept by the project precisely because those files must not parse.

reasons.AttDef: a Property symbol plus a `contains` edge from the element it is declared for
reasons.AttlistDecl: the element whose attributes are declared here
reasons.Attribute: a property of its element, and the source of `references` / `imports` edges for its value
reasons.EmptyElemTag: empty tag: carries the element Name and the Attribute list
reasons.ExternalID: a file reference on a doctypedecl, entity or notation
reasons.GEDecl: a general entity declaration: a Type symbol owned by the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
reasons.NDataDecl: the notation an unparsed entity points at: a `contains` edge
reasons.Name: the name-bearing leaf for tags, attributes, PIs, DTD declarations and notations
reasons.NotationDecl: a notation declaration: a Type symbol owned by the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
reasons.NotationType: the notations an attribute may carry: each Name leaf becomes a `contains` edge
reasons.PEDecl: a parameter entity declaration: a Type symbol owned by the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
reasons.PI: a processing instruction: a Module symbol owned by its enclosing element
reasons.PITarget: the name-bearing leaf of a PI
reasons.PseudoAtt: a pseudo-attribute of a StyleSheetPI / XmlModelPI
reasons.PseudoAttValue: the value of a pseudo-attribute; `href` is a file path
reasons.PubidLiteral: the public identifier inside a PUBLIC ExternalID
reasons.PublicID: a file reference on a NotationDecl
reasons.STag: start tag: carries the element Name and the Attribute list
reasons.StyleSheetPI: a file reference: the PI spelling the `xml-stylesheet` external token produces
reasons.SystemLiteral: the file path inside a SYSTEM ExternalID
reasons.XmlModelPI: a file reference: the PI spelling the `xml-model` external token produces
reasons.contentspec: the content model of an element declaration; each Name leaf becomes a `contains` edge
reasons.doctypedecl: a Type symbol naming the DTD, plus its ExternalID import
reasons.document: walk root; the root element is reached through the walk
reasons.element: the document's structural unit: a symbol plus a `contains` edge from its parent element
reasons.elementdecl: a Type symbol for a DTD element declaration; its contentspec is the content model
reasons.prolog: container: XMLDecl, doctypedecl and the misc PIs/comments under it are dispatched from here
reasons.ERROR: counted, not walked: real-xml-analyzer.ts:668 reads node.isError to record a file's grammar-error count, so the analyzer consults it and the class is handled. ERROR is a tree-sitter pseudo-node, not a grammar construct — see internal_silent MISSING for the paired one.

pass_through_classified._rule: walked THROUGH deliberately, each with the reason, so a pass-through is a decision on record and not a shrug

reasons.CharRef: a numeric character reference, not a name
reasons.DefaultDecl: the literal #REQUIRED / #IMPLIED / #FIXED value, not a name
reasons.ETag: the repaired grammar rejects a mismatched end name, so the name adds nothing
reasons.EncName: the encoding pseudo-attribute literal inside an XMLDecl, not a name
reasons.EntityRef: a USE; the declaration is GEDecl / PEDecl
reasons.EntityValue: an entity's replacement text, not a name
reasons.Enumeration: wrapper over the Nmtokens of a DTD attribute type
reasons.Mixed: `(#PCDATA|a|b)*` — the names are read from the Name leaves, not the wrapper
reasons.Nmtoken: an enumeration member is a token, not a name
reasons.PEReference: inside an internal subset a PEReference is a DeclSep — a separator, not a use
reasons.StringType: the literal CDATA, not a name
reasons.TokenizedType: the literal ID / IDREF / … token, not a name
reasons.URI: the aliased body of a SystemLiteral; the edge target is the enclosing literal, and the LITERAL carries the edge line
reasons.VersionNum: the version pseudo-attribute literal inside an XMLDecl, not a name
reasons.XMLDecl: `xml` is reserved; version and encoding are not declarations
reasons._intSubsetItem: hidden rule; the repeat that carries a subset's declarations and conditional sections
reasons.children: the element content model; its Name leaves are the declarations that matter
reasons.conditionalSect: an INCLUDE/IGNORE section inside an internal subset; walked through so the declarations it guards are reached
reasons.content: an element's child sequence: walked through so each child element is reached; nothing on it is a name

internal_silent._rule: The gate has exactly FOUR buckets — handled_verified, internal_silent, gap, and a design_decision carrying a node_type — so `internal_silent` is the UNION of 'walked through with no output' and 'walked through to read a child'. A pass-through is a member of it. Derived from the analyzer's own PASSTHROUGH_LITERALS plus the hidden rules, so it cannot drift; the FIRST version of this file listed only the former and the gate reported `Mixed` and `children` as in NO bucket, which is the gate being right and this file being behind.

gap._rule: an observed node type in NO bucket. xml's list is EMPTY by construction and that is the claim worth gating: the analyzer declares a vocabulary, the corpus census is measured against it, and `script/m12/xml-node-types-compare.ts` check B fails on the first unclassified type. The list is emitted from the gate's own result, so it cannot be quietly emptied.
gap.evidence: validation/m12/results/xml-shape-safety.json — check B, `every node type seen in fixtures, probes and the corpus is classified`, green over 49 observed named types

design_decision._rule: the relationship ontology and the refusals, each RULED on a measurement. A record with no node_type documents a resolved defect or a whole-concept refusal and classifies nothing.

notApplicable.measured: XML declares no procedure. A DTD entity carries an EntityValue or an ExternalID, never a parameter list, and no corpus file contains anything a call edge could name. The closest construct — an XSLT `call-template` — names a template DECLARATION, and it is emitted as `references`, which is what it is.

no type system. An XSD names a type by an ATTRIBUTE VALUE and links to it with a `references` edge: 11,117 resolvable QName references over 511 files. A `complexType` is not a subclass of another, it REFERENCES one by `base` — and publishing that as `extends` would be a category error the M60.R10 class of finding is about.
an XML document has no public surface to export. The whole file is the surface and the document element is already a symbol.

routed (`.dtd` is in EXTENSION_LANGUAGE) but NOT representable: the xml grammar's `document` rule requires a document element, so a standalone DTD's root node type is ERROR. Measured: `cond_sect1.dtd` 11 ERROR nodes, `cond_sect2.dtd` 8, the W3C `XMLSchema.dtd` 170 — while upstream's SEPARATE `dtd` grammar parses all of them with 0. Filed as owed, with its measurement, in grammars/tree-sitter-xml/PIN.md; the corpus files are declared negative controls rather than excluded by a glob.

kindRulings.contains: structural containment read straight off the tree: element->element, element->attribute, element->namespace, DTD->declaration, declaration->content-model member, declaration->notation, PI->target. Every contains TARGET is a published symbol in the same file — enforced structurally, not by convention, and pinned by `xml/dtd-declarations` (`every contains target resolves to a symbol in the same file`).
kindRulings.references: a NAME, never a written value. The target of an XSD/RelaxNG/XSLT reference is the LOCAL NAME and the prefix rides in metadata, because a prefix in a target is a value where a name belongs (M60.R10). An edge is emitted only when the target resolves in the document or is a specification built-in — 1,319 unresolved values are REFUSED rather than published.
kindRulings.imports: a FILE PATH, which is the one case where a value IS the right target: a DOCTYPE's ExternalID, a DTD entity's or notation's ExternalID, a StyleSheetPI/XmlModelPI `href`, and an XSD `schemaLocation` URI. 630 distinct schemaLocation targets and 11 external-ID imports were emitted where the pre-fix lane emitted 0.

line.note: every relationship carries a line, and 100% of them are on the line the TARGET NAME is written on (M59.A7 / #825). Pre-fix: the external-ID edge took the ExternalID node's line, so a multi-line PUBLIC doctype pointed at the keyword — 310 wrong-line edges, now 18. Pinned by all 8 fixtures, and by the multi-line doctype in `xml/dtd-declarations`, which is the shape that makes the keyword-line mutant non-vacuous.

occurrences.note: edge collapse is COUNTED, not hidden. Edge identity is `source|type|target`, so N declarations of one pair necessarily share one edge — 492,774 occurrences on 45,297 edges. The edge keeps the EARLIEST line the name is written on, not the first the LIFO walk reached. Pinned by `xml/edge-collapse`.

syntaxErrors.note: a symbol or edge from a file the analyzer reports as erroneous says so. Pre-fix: 27,228 symbols over 177 files, unlabelled, and the shipped 'creates no recovery symbols' check was a FIXTURE ACCIDENT. Suppressing them would be wrong (177 of 177 are `##` Maven-archetype templates), so they are labelled. Pinned by `xml/recovery-labelling`, including the negative half — a clean file carries no label, so the flag cannot become noise.

declaredName.note: in a declaration vocabulary the DECLARED name is an attribute VALUE, and the tag name is kept as `meta.tagName` so the structural reading is carried rather than overwritten. Gated on the element's EFFECTIVE NAMESPACE: 29,196 `name` attributes outside any declaration vocabulary are DATA and must not be renamed, which is why the rule is not tag-gated. Recall 0.045 -> 0.696 over 26,578 in-vocabulary declarations.

resolvable.note: a `references` edge records whether its target resolves `in-document` or is a specification `builtin`, so a consumer can tell a resolved edge from a built-in one without re-deriving the namespace bindings.
